mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP indicates strong economic growth, which should positively impact the S&P 500 over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 6% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If unemployment exceeds 6% but S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production and employment both increase, it indicates strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If both proxies increase but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in federal funds rate leads to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases by 0.5% but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Higher inflation as indicated by CPI leads to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days due to potential rate hikes.
failure_condition: If CPI increases but S&P 500 returns are positive more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: If housing starts increase by 10,000 but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 45% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales and employment both grow, it signals strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If both proxies increase but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 35% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, low unemployment and slowing industrial production indicate potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE is below 5% and INDPRO growth slows but S&P 500 returns are positive more than 40% of the time.
